name: Plugin Safety Scanner / 插件安全扫描
description: Scans the MT Manager plugins installed on this device and reports what each one is able to do, checks them and the files MT Manager can read against ClamAV-format malware signatures you load, then lets you quarantine or remove the malicious ones with a tap. Open this plugin's settings screen to scan. / 扫描本机已安装的 MT 管理器插件，报告每个插件的实际能力，用您导入的 ClamAV 格式特征库检查插件及 MT 管理器可读取的文件，并可一键隔离或删除恶意插件。打开本插件设置页即开始扫描。
